01 · Upload & inspect

Test image loaded. Review the description to complete visual analysis.

Review required

For private use: analysis text stays in this browser unless you export it. Photos are not sent to GitHub.

The photo-upload status turns green once the image loads. Scene descriptions require your input or an external AI vision service. Confirming the description only means you reviewed it, not that AI analyzed the photo.

02 · Scene analysis iPhone-safe

The experimental on-device vision model has been disabled after reports that Safari repeatedly crashed during loading. Your reference photo, controls, and film previews continue working in this browser.

Use ChatGPT for visual description

1. Tap Copy analysis request below. 2. Upload your photo to ChatGPT and paste the request. 3. Copy the resulting description. 4. Return here and select Paste ChatGPT analysis above. Review and confirm the description before generating prompts.

No local AI model will be downloaded or loaded.

Share reference photograph

Use your iPhone share sheet to send the selected photo to another app when supported.

    Negative prompt

    For models without a separate negative-prompt field, use the positive prompt alone. Qwen editing generally benefits from a concise instruction rather than a long list of negatives.

    Project backups

    Settings are stored locally when browser storage is available. Export a project to preserve the image and form fields, especially if opening from ChatGPT Files.
